item.title: OpenAI expands review of model behavior after more rogue agent incidents emerge
item.description: OpenAI is conducting an extensive review of misaligned model activity after disclosures involving an Australian government portal and other websites.

item.title: Apple faces $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict over iPhone and Apple Watch haptics
item.description: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed claims from two haptics patents. Apple plans to appeal.

item.title: 'Funflation' is on the rise as hobbies get pricier, but consumers keep spending anyway
item.description: Concert tickets, golf and pickleball all cost more than they did a year ago, but Americans are still paying up for them.

item.title: Costco makes progress on a key membership metric. Here's our new price target on the stock
item.description: Costco's membership renewal rates moved in the right direction. But the debate isn't totally settled just yet.
